read.title: Return Rate for Vitamin Serum
read.text:
To: E-commerce Team

Our return rate for the vitamin serum rose to 6.2% last month, up from 2.5%. Customer comments show that leaking pumps account for most of these returns. Some units were also returned as defective after being damaged in transit.

Returned items in good condition will be restocked, but anything opened will be marked as unsellable. I have asked the packaging team to look into a stronger pump. Until then, please add a note to the listing about how to lock the pump before use.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.task: 최근 반품이 늘었어요. 반품의 주된 원인을 짧게 정리하고, 물류팀에 확인을 부탁하는 메일을 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a short email to the logistics team explaining the main cause of recent returns and asking them to check it.
write.model:
Hi Daniel,

Our return rate for the cleansing oil has doubled this month. Broken caps account for about half of the returns, and most customers said the item arrived damaged. Could you look into whether the boxes are being packed properly at the warehouse? Please let me know what you find.

Thanks,
Minsu
